description: Sticky note windows: only what src/routes/sticky/+page.svelte and src/lib/desktop.ts use there — the change-event bus, own-window geometry (scaleFactor/outerPosition/innerSize/outerSize/currentMonitor + moved/resized events, setPosition for the tuck-away slide), drag region, close-on-unpin, always-on-top. No window creation, no dialog/opener/autostart: a sticky renders note content, so it gets the smallest surface.
